cens_none.label: COVID censored
cens_none.note: The COVID quarters (2020Q2 and Q3) are dropped before the regime models are fitted (the chart skips them).

std_90.label: + 1990-style recession
std_90.note: Real data to 2026Q3 plus a SIMULATED mild recession shaped like 1990-91, starting 2026Q4 and followed by a recovery and one more year of expansion (orange region; not real data). COVID quarters kept.

extra_cols.label: Pr in new recession
extra_cols.tip: Mean Pr(low regime) over the simulated recession quarters

extra_cols.label: Detection lag (quarters)
extra_cols.tip: Quarters from the first simulated recession quarter until Pr(low) >= 0.5 (smoothed, whole sample; never = -1)

extra_cols.label: False alarms
extra_cols.tip: Share of the other simulated-period quarters (the recovery and the extra year of expansion) with Pr(low) of 50% or more

extra_cols.label: AUC, new period
extra_cols.tip: AUC of Pr(low) against the simulated recession indicator over the simulated period

extra_cols.label: Real-time lag, >=50% (quarters)
extra_cols.tip: Pseudo-real-time (refit on data up to each quarter): quarters from the first simulated recession quarter until the real-time Pr(low) reaches 50%

extra_cols.label: Real-time signal lag (2 q >=80%)
extra_cols.tip: Quarters until two consecutive real-time probabilities are both 80% or more (a quarterly version of the recession signal); the lag is measured at the second quarter

extra_cols.label: Real-time false alarms
extra_cols.tip: Share of the evaluated non-recession quarters from 2026Q4 on whose real-time Pr(low) is 50% or more
